skill.name: technical-debt-assessment
skill.description: Assess, quantify, and prioritize technical debt using code analysis, metrics, and impact analysis. Use when planning refactoring, evaluating codebases, or making architectural decisions.

generated_query: We're planning to refactor our legacy React application's codebase. Could you scan the 50+ TypeScript files in the `src/` directory for common issues: `any` types, functions over 30 lines, magic numbers, console statements, and TODO comments? For each issue found, estimate the effort to fix (in hours), the impact on maintainability (1–10), and the monthly cost (in hours) if left unresolved. Then produce a markdown report with a summary (total items, total effort, monthly interest) and a prioritized list of the top 10 items showing category, severity, effort, impact, and interest. Assume categories: `code`, `architecture`, `test`, `documentation`, and `security`.
